breakpoints.note: The staged crash stack reaches `parse_ofp_str__` line 1737, which is only executed after `ofpacts_parse_instructions(act_str, &pp)` succeeds and materializes the parsed action list.
This is the first project statement that consumes the attacker-controlled action substring returned after `action=` and materializes the vulnerable `ofpact_learn` state.

This assignment stores the wide destination width into `spec->n_bits`, whose vulnerable type is `uint8_t` in `include/openvswitch/ofp-actions.h`. The narrowing truncates the length later used to step across immediate data. The fix widens `n_bits` to `uint32_t`.

The forged interior spec created from the first immediate payload passes a bogus `struct mf_subfield` into `mf_check__`. Evaluating `sf->field->n_bits` dereferences its non-null invalid `field` pointer and triggers the observed MemorySanitizer SEGV on READ.
